<section id="release-process">
<h1>Release process</h1>
<p>This document describes how to build, validate, and publish a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code>
release.</p>
<section id="prerequisites">
<h2>Prerequisites</h2>
<p>Install build and validation tools:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>pip<span class="w"> </span>install<span class="w"> </span>-e<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;.[dev,docs,release]&quot;</span>
<span class="c1"># or, equivalently:</span>
python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>pip<span class="w"> </span>install<span class="w"> </span>-e<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;.[dev]&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>pip<span class="w"> </span>install<span class="w"> </span>build<span class="w"> </span>twine
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code> uses hatch-vcs for versioning. Installing or building the project
generates a gitignored <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore/_version.py</span></code> that exposes
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore.__version__</span></code>; do not commit that file.
Direct source-tree imports fall back to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">0.0.0+unknown</span></code> when that generated
module is absent.</p>
</section>
<section id="pre-release-checklist">
<h2>Pre-release checklist</h2>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p>Ensure all tests pass:</p></li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>pytest<span class="w"> </span>-q
</pre></div>
</div>
<ol class="arabic simple" start="2">
<li><p>Ensure lint is clean:</p></li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>ruff<span class="w"> </span>check<span class="w"> </span>.
</pre></div>
</div>
<ol class="arabic simple" start="3">
<li><p>Ensure type checking passes:</p></li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>mypy<span class="w"> </span>ledgercore
</pre></div>
</div>
<ol class="arabic simple" start="4">
<li><p>Ensure formatting and documentation are clean:</p></li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>ruff<span class="w"> </span>format<span class="w"> </span>--check<span class="w"> </span>.
python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>sphinx<span class="w"> </span>-W<span class="w"> </span>-b<span class="w"> </span>html<span class="w"> </span>docs<span class="w"> </span>docs/_build/html
</pre></div>
</div>
<ol class="arabic simple" start="5">
<li><p>Ensure a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LICENSE</span></code> file is present and ships in the built artifacts:</p></li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nb">test</span><span class="w"> </span>-f<span class="w"> </span>LICENSE
</pre></div>
</div>
<ol class="arabic simple" start="6">
<li><p>Ensure examples run from the source tree with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PYTHONPATH=.</span> <span class="pre">python</span> <span class="pre">examples/*.py</span></code>
(or after installing the package).</p></li>
</ol>
</section>
<section id="building">
<h2>Building</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>build
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Builds from a non-git source archive are supported when the intended version is
provided explicitly:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nv">SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="m">0</span>.2.0<span class="w"> </span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>build
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>This produces <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">dist/ledgercore-&lt;version&gt;.tar.gz</span></code> and
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">dist/ledgercore-&lt;version&gt;-py3-none-any.whl</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="validating-the-distribution">
<h2>Validating the distribution</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>twine<span class="w"> </span>check<span class="w"> </span>dist/*
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="smoke-testing-required-release-gate">
<h2>Smoke testing (required release gate)</h2>
<p>Install the built wheel into a clean virtualenv and run the smoke test. Use a
writable location for the venv (on some platforms <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">/tmp</span></code> is not writable):</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nv">smoke_dir</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="k">$(</span><span class="nb">pwd</span><span class="k">)</span><span class="s2">/.smoke&quot;</span>
rm<span class="w"> </span>-rf<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="nv">$smoke_dir</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span>
python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>venv<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="nv">$smoke_dir</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span>
<span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="nv">$smoke_dir</span><span class="s2">/bin/python&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>pip<span class="w"> </span>install<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="k">$(</span><span class="nb">echo</span><span class="w"> </span>dist/*.whl<span class="k">)</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span>
<span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="nv">$smoke_dir</span><span class="s2">/bin/python&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>-<span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&lt;&lt;&#39;PY&#39;</span>
<span class="s">from pathlib import Path</span>
<span class="s">import tempfile</span>
<span class="s">from ledgercore import __version__</span>
<span class="s">from ledgercore.ids import LedgerIdFormat</span>
<span class="s">from ledgercore.refs import parse_resource_ref</span>
<span class="s">from ledgercore.frontmatter import render_front_matter_text, split_front_matter_text</span>
<span class="s">from ledgercore.jsonl import load_jsonl_object_map, write_jsonl_objects</span>
<span class="s">from ledgercore.time import utc_now_iso</span>

<span class="s">assert isinstance(__version__, str) and __version__</span>
<span class="s">assert LedgerIdFormat(prefix=&quot;task&quot;).format(1) == &quot;task-0001&quot;</span>
<span class="s">assert parse_resource_ref(&quot;tl:task-0001&quot;).global_ref == &quot;tl:task-0001&quot;</span>
<span class="s">text = render_front_matter_text({&quot;id&quot;: &quot;task-0001&quot;, &quot;flag&quot;: &quot;no&quot;}, &quot;# Body\n&quot;, scalar_style=&quot;minimal&quot;)</span>
<span class="s">meta, body = split_front_matter_text(text)</span>
<span class="s">assert meta[&quot;id&quot;] == &quot;task-0001&quot; and meta[&quot;flag&quot;] == &quot;no&quot; and body == &quot;# Body\n&quot;</span>
<span class="s">with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:</span>
<span class="s">    path = Path(d) / &quot;rows.jsonl&quot;</span>
<span class="s">    write_jsonl_objects(path, [{&quot;id&quot;: &quot;a&quot;, &quot;v&quot;: 1}, {&quot;id&quot;: &quot;b&quot;, &quot;v&quot;: 2}])</span>
<span class="s">    result = load_jsonl_object_map(path, key=&quot;id&quot;)</span>
<span class="s">    assert not result.issues and set(result.rows_by_key) == {&quot;a&quot;, &quot;b&quot;}</span>
<span class="s">assert utc_now_iso().endswith(&quot;Z&quot;)</span>
<span class="s">print(&quot;ledgercore smoke test passed&quot;)</span>
<span class="s">PY</span>
rm<span class="w"> </span>-rf<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="nv">$smoke_dir</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Also verify the built artifacts ship the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LICENSE</span></code> file and the generated
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore/_version.py</span></code>:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-<span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&lt;&lt;&#39;PY&#39;</span>
<span class="s">import glob, tarfile, zipfile</span>
<span class="s">wheel = glob.glob(&quot;dist/*.whl&quot;)[0]</span>
<span class="s">sdist = glob.glob(&quot;dist/*.tar.gz&quot;)[0]</span>
<span class="s">with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel) as z:</span>
<span class="s">    names = z.namelist()</span>
<span class="s">    assert any(name.endswith(&quot;LICENSE&quot;) for name in names)</span>
<span class="s">    assert &quot;ledgercore/_version.py&quot; in names</span>
<span class="s">with tarfile.open(sdist) as t:</span>
<span class="s">    names = t.getnames()</span>
<span class="s">    assert any(name.endswith(&quot;/LICENSE&quot;) for name in names)</span>
<span class="s">    assert any(name.endswith(&quot;/ledgercore/_version.py&quot;) for name in names)</span>
<span class="s">print(&quot;artifact check passed&quot;)</span>
<span class="s">PY</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="publishing">
<h2>Publishing</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>twine<span class="w"> </span>upload<span class="w"> </span>dist/*
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="version-policy">
<h2>Version policy</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code> is pre-1.0. Public APIs are intended to be stable within the
0.2.x series, but breaking changes may still happen before 1.0.0 when needed
to keep the core API small and consistent.</p>
</section>
</section>
